html:
The Tjalkadjara, or Tjalkanti, are an Aboriginal people recorded in the Western Desert of Western Australia, east of Laverton toward the Great Victoria Desert.

They spoke a form of the Western Desert language. Neighbours on the map include the Mandjindja and Nyanganyatjara. Little is written about them as a separate group. Like other desert peoples of Aboriginal Australia, they moved in small family groups between rockholes and soaks.
sum: The Tjalkadjara, or Tjalkanti, are an Aboriginal people recorded in the Western Desert of Western Australia, east of Laverton toward the Great Victoria Desert.
